summary: Listed under Davidson County in an NC lookout compilation; no build date, design or current status in the sources read.

evidence.supports: tower list gives coordinates and Davidson County

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: the record and both sources give only name, county and coordinates. The Eastern US Lookouts NC entry is just the heading 'Midway' and 'Davidson County', with no photo caption, date, design or agency. Do not confuse with easternuslookouts.weebly.com/midway.html, which is a different Midway (Lafayette County). The same NC page's High Rock entry (Davidson County, Healing Springs mountain) quotes a 1954 clipping calling High Rock 'the first forest fire spotting tower ever erected in Davidson County'. If a Midway tower predates 1954 those accounts conflict; no source gives Midway's date, so this is unchecked. The NC page carries a Midway photo (uploads/1/5/9/1/1591048/8732991_orig.png) with no licence; not added. A search snippet mentioned a photo caption calling a tall structure over Midway a water tower; not verified, not used.
